questions.q: What does Lord Henry claim is the only worthwhile pursuit?
questions.why: He argues that only beauty matters, as stated early in the novel.

questions.q: What does Dorian wish would age instead of him?
questions.why: He offers his soul for the portrait to bear the signs of aging.

questions.q: How does Dorian react when Basil confronts him about rumors?
questions.why: Dorian reveals the grotesque portrait to Basil instead of admitting fault.

questions.q: Who does Dorian kill after blaming him for his downfall?
questions.why: He murders the artist Basil after shifting blame.

questions.q: What final act does Dorian attempt to redeem himself?
questions.why: He decides to change his life and pursue virtue before his end.
